improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical for B2B audiences. Including keywords like Claude-powered, AI assistant, trade, and business improves relevance for target search queries.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers to your business questions, anytime. Try three free searches and see how Gideon can support your operations."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clearly communicates its purpose (AI assistant for trade and business). The subheading reinforces the core value prop (instant answers, always available) while highlighting the risk-free trial offer, reducing friction for new visitors to engage. The copy is direct, avoids hype, and speaks to the target audience of business owners and traders.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to join as a member to continue accessing Gideon. Membership starts at just US$2 per day, and you can choose monthly or annual billing—annual members save 30 percent. As a member, you'll unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the user journey—the transition from free trial to paid membership. It reassures prospects by clearly explaining what to expect, reinforces value with specific pricing and savings, and reduces hesitation by framing the paywall as an invitation rather than a barrier.
